acceptanceCriteria: On a REUSE push, shard 0 takes at most shards 1-5 plus 0.5 min.
A gofmt violation fails go-product within 5 min.
Required go-product coverage is unchanged; V1-0359 Windows test vet included.
body: Found 2026-10-10 by the CI audit (report /private/tmp/claude-501/gotmp/ci-audit.md; 60 ci.yml runs; main run 38055182050). PR wall median 39.8 min, critical path always go-product-shard 0. Shard 0 runs ~2.3 min of serial work no other shard does (helper self-tests, gofmt, vet, Windows build, interop) after the race tests (ci.yml ~421-433), so a gofmt/vet failure surfaces only after ~38 min and shard 0 still takes 2.9 min on REUSE pushes vs 0.6 min for others. Move it to a parallel go-static job that go-product depends on, so required coverage is unchanged (AFP-V0-013). Can absorb V1-0359 (Windows test vet).
title: ci: move static, helper self-test and interop work off go-product-shard 0 into a parallel job
